messages.author: c7ffcfaebad9edef
messages.subject: [JIRA] (SPARKR-196) wrong scope in slave process
parts:
Shivaram Venkataraman commented on SPARKR-196
 
Re: wrong scope in slave process

Thanks Antonio Piccolboni for reporting this bug. It took a while to track this down and it turns out the bug is actually in the way we serialize dependencies. When we try to capture the value for `t` the `base` environment is picked up before `GlobalEnv` – I am not sure why the `base` package env comes up before `GlobalEnv` in the parent traversal order and I don't know of a good work-around yet.

cc hao – It might be interesting to see if this error goes away in the new dependency capture proposed in https://github.com/amplab-extras/SparkR-pkg/pull/158
